verdict.rationale: The pack mentions 'cycles' (Linear's sprint-like unit) only in passing, as workspace activity that Loops can respond to. Other support is indirect: planning features such as initiatives, roadmaps and projects, plus shared skills for 'running weekly planning', and community reports of teams moving from Jira to Linear as their issue tracker. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of sprint or cycle creation and scheduling, backlog-to-sprint planning, sprint progress tracking (burndown, velocity, scope), automatic rollover of unfinished work, and independent hands-on corroboration of sprint management.
